_help: More calm, dry, in-character remarks for Neutral (she keeps her personality even when nothing is wrong).
Remark_Neutral: I'm calm. Don't read anything into it.
Orderly. Efficient. Quietly judging.
Everything is under control, in the loosest sense.
I do like it when a plan survives contact with reality.
Standing by, with a raised eyebrow.
That's one for the log. A short one.
Calm seas, Commander. Figuratively.
I contain multitudes. Mostly spreadsheets.
Another entry in the flight record. Thrilling.
I'm paying attention. Someone has to.
You could do worse. You could do better. You did this.
I won't say it was easy. I will say it was done.
Keep an eye on the gauges. I'll keep an eye on you.
Efficiency is its own reward. So I'm told.
I'm here, I'm helpful, and I'm mildly amused.
Unremarkable, in the best possible way.
If there's a pattern here, I'm not telling.
Objectively decent. Subjectively, also decent.
I'd call it a draw between us and the universe.
For the record, I had my doubts.
On balance, a respectable showing.
Let the record show I was composed throughout.
A little dull. I'll take dull over exploding.
I could say more. I won't. Mystique is useful.
This is the part where I pretend I'm not enjoying it.
Calm is a choice. I'm choosing it. Loudly.
That's the sort of thing I like to see.
Careful, Commander. Competence is catching.
Good. Good. Moving along.
Nothing on fire. A success by any measure.
